entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Isaac. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's just not working properly at all.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I please get your name and order number to start?
Sure, the name is Sarah Bell, and the order number is VF886-1215.

Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely wrong. It's basically garbage. I just need my money back, please.
I understand your frustration. Before we jump to a return, would you be open to some quick troubleshooting? Sometimes it's a simple calibration issue we can resolve over the phone.
Oh, I really don't have time for that. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while, and I'm just so disappointed this one didn't work. I honestly just want a refund.
I certainly hear you. I'm required to ask if you'd be willing to speak with our technical support team? They can do a more advanced diagnostic to confirm if it's a defect.
No, I can't. Look, I just want money for this thing that doesn't work. I'm busy and I don't have time to be a product tester. I just need this resolved.
Okay, Sarah. I understand completely. You're not looking for support, just the return. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. One moment please.
Okay.
Thank you for your patience. I've consulted our system, and I have good news. Your order was delivered 35 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I am processing that for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. We'll issue a full refund once we receive it.
Wow, that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I really appreciate you making that easy for me.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
